HowPartners.dc.html: How we choose partners
About Settle
Settle is free for newcomers. Some partners pay to appear — here's how that works.
Our rules
Official government steps always come first and are never paid.
Free help (settlement agencies, legal clinics) comes next and is never paid.
Sponsored partners are labelled "Sponsored" and shown last.
Partners never see your answers, your family or your location.
Partners can't change, reorder or hide official steps.
We never take referral fees from lawyers or immigration consultants.
How a partner gets listed
They serve newcomers in the area shown
They're licensed or registered where the law requires it
Their offer is checked for clear, fair terms
They can be removed if newcomers report problems
